name: kinetica
description: Kinetica Editor in Claude: a robotics editor on rigid-body physics (Box3D) - the model builds, drives and tests robots in it, explains them with formulas and films it. The editor's MCP server and skills.

python.title: Python
python.description: The Python 3.8+ the editor's MCP server runs on: python3 (Linux, macOS) or python (Windows)

editor.title: Kinetica folder
editor.description: Where Kinetica is installed; empty: ~/Kinetica/editor (Windows: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Kinetica\editor), as install.sh and install.ps1 put it

plugins.title: Kinetica plugins folder
plugins.description: A folder of the editor's plugins - formulas, narration, chess, the depz sensors (github.com/Kinetica-Labs/kinetica-plugins): the editor started from Claude runs them, and their commands are Claude's tools; empty: the editor's own only
